notes.title: Big UPDATE!
notes.content:
[b]Critical:[/b]
Fixed a bug with overpriced dish sales during time skips.
Fixed a bug with visitors getting stuck in toilets.
Fixed a bug with equipment breakdowns.
Fixed a bug in the dish action menu upon restaurant closure and waiter selection of current dishes.

[b]Visual changes:[/b]
Waiter's desktop now shows more detailed information on orders during both working hours and at the end of the workday.
Visual indication of customer moods.
Adjustment of stock display values when unloading goods (decimal points removed).
Improved dish management menu.
Smooth transition of lighting between time shifts.
Overhauled employee skill upgrade menu.
Added indication of current balance in staff training and product ordering menus.
Added highlighting and statuses for the restaurant management panel.
Added hints for possible actions with objects in decoration and construction mode.
City update.
Added time and date to the interface.
Expanded mail menu to show player responses.
Changed display of work schedule for promoters.
Fixed display of stock item quantities and logic for displaying order quantities.
Fixed display of product availability in stock when overfilled.

[b]Bugs:[/b]
Fixed "Marty McFly" bug with police officers surfing through the air without moving their legs.
Fixed visitors getting stuck in the toilet during fast time skips.
Fixed water and gas consumption bug during time skips.
Fixed broken plates bug in the dishwashing area.
Fixed bug with kitchen electricity not being connected.
Fixed premature exit from repair mode without saving successful repair information.
Fixed dialogue events bug after restaurant closure.
Fixed duplicate items bug in hands.
Fixed staff schedule settings bug.
Fixed bug of janitors ignoring broken dishes.
Fixed bug with job rejection for employees.
Fixed bug with dirty dishes for new visitors.
Fixed bug with promoter schedule saving.
Fixed bug with dishes upon manual or timed restaurant closure.
Fixed product ordering bug.
Fixed bug with customers and passersby losing consciousness.

[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]
Changed water consumption calculation.
Now you can open and close taps both in your own and competitor's premises.
Employees work worse during time skips.
Customers now leave reviews about the restaurant during time skips.
Restaurant tables are also cleaned during time skips.
Waiters clear dirty dishes if there are no unserved tables or undelivered orders.
Customers served at 0% instantly leave the restaurant.
Lack of chemicals during restaurant operation leads to dishes being served on dirty plates until the end of the shift or premature restaurant closure. Serving dishes on dirty dishes significantly affects customer ratings.
Utensils appear on tables when orders are taken from customers.
Visitors no longer sit at tables with dirty dishes.
Simplified mini-game for delivering dirty dishes.
Selected items for ordering are no longer reset when exiting the inventory menu.
When goods are received in stock, dishes for which there were not enough ingredients become available for ordering again.
Price rebalance: reduced the cost of skill upgrades, cost of products, and staff wages.
New employee skill mechanics.
Reworked employee skills.

[b]Other:[/b]
Reworked tutorial.
Kitchen equipment and tutorial malfunction sounds are now twice as quiet.
Rebalanced costs of electricity, water, and gas.
Optimization of city residents and police officers.
Fixed error in indicating inflated prices.
Price setting for dishes via sliders.
Added the ability to select options in the dialog menu using the mouse.
Added notification during time skip if you have no waiter on staff.
Over 80 new city residents.
Ability to interact with employees.
Added quick transition from the restaurant menu to the product ordering menu.

notes.title: A big update is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Critical:[/b]
Fixed a bug where the player could not take a dish for delivery
Fixed a bug with saving in the camera after which it was impossible to go free
Fixed a bug where the delivery vehicle got stuck when it appeared
Fixed a bug in the new game when the player waited a long time in the introductory menu
Fixed end of day registration bug
Fixed a bug with delivery orders at the end of the working week
Fixed a bug with visitors in the toilet when rewinding time
Fixed a bug where a restaurant with debts closed on the fourth day instead of the third


[b]Visual changes:[/b]
The "Camera" application on the laptop has been replaced with the "Knowledge Base" application
Enemy restaurant design improved
Fixed issues with tooltip interface issues
Improved main menu


[b]Bugs:[/b]
Fixed a bug where clients got stuck when tables were close together
Fixed client unconscious bug
Fixed a bug where tables were not kept clean
Fixed a bug with negative value of regular customers
Fixed a bug in installing floor objects. After pointing at the window, the object stopped checking installation positions
Fixed a bug updating the quantity of goods when ordering
Fixed a hang bug when opening a toilet door with a master key
Fixed a bug indicating the status "No dishes to order"
Fixed a bug with opening a lock from a prison
Fixed a bug in saving player restaurant reviews
Fixed a bug with a negative deposit value


[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]
Added equipment breakdown mechanics
Added mechanics for repairing electrical appliances
Added mechanics for calling a repairman
You no longer have a valve for the gas pipeline from the start of the game
Clients visit the toilet and use toilet paper
The toilet may become clogged after use.
Cleaning the toilet requires chemicals in stock
Your restaurant no longer closes if you go to jail
To repair the electrical panel, you now need to call a repairman or repair it yourself (mini-game of repairing electrical appliances)
Added a menu stand to a competitor's restaurant. Now you can view your competitor's menu
Added mechanics for upgrading your restaurant door locks
The ability of a competitor to break into your restaurant will be reduced by locking the doors and purchasing the best door locks
Now a competitor can break your kitchen appliances and clog your toilet
Changed the chances of a competitor creating a mischief in your restaurant
A competitor fixes the restaurant's problems and restarts it during business hours
Emails from the same sender no longer work as a thread and are sent as separate messages for ease of navigation


[b]Other:[/b]
Completely redesigned tutorial
Added detailed documentation about game mechanics
Added a new equipment repair task
Improved and optimized reflection in mirrors
Customization: Added laminate category and 7 laminate options
Fixed message when trying to open a restaurant before the start of the working day
Added "Overpriced" status if all dishes on your menu are in the red price zone
Fixed police subtitles during arrest
Added dates for messages in mail
Fixed city car colliders
Added splash and introductory text

notes.title: Read changelog
notes.content:
[b]Critical:[/b]
Fixed the problem of missing a working day, which led to crashes and the game not working correctly
Fixed a bug with exiting the action menu when servicing clients


[b]Visual changes:[/b]
Added menu stands for restaurants where you can see the list of dishes, their status and price
Added tablet with task list
Added billboard in the city


[b]Bugs:[/b]
Fixed a bug when the waiter served one table and ignored all the others
Fixed a bug in the sound of toilet stalls
Fixed a bug where the competitor's waiters did not issue orders, which greatly spoiled his rating
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to rehire an employee who was fired


[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]
Added food delivery mechanics
Having a waiter on shift is no longer necessary to open a restaurant
Any available waiter can bring the order to the client. Previously, the dish was brought by the waiter who served these clients
Client event chance reduced from 33% to 15%
Added price management for the restaurant menu
Added goal mechanics for winning
Added mechanics for renting advertisements on billboards
Added mechanics for hiring a promoter who distributes leaflets near your restaurant
Added mechanics for cleaning up trash and dirty dishes
Customers leave stains on the table that need to be wiped, otherwise this will affect the assessment of the cleanliness of the establishment for future visitors
Waiters clear dirty dishes from tables
New system for ordering dishes by the client:
- customers do not order overpriced dishes
- reduce the service rating for dishes that are not available for order due to the lack of products for them
New mechanics for clogged and unclogged toilets


[b]Other:[/b]
Now it gets dark from 18:00
Adjustments to client positions at the table, now the client’s legs do not fall into the floor
Added autosave

notes.content:
[b]Critical:[/b]
Fixed a bug where it was possible to duplicate personnel through the hiring system

[b]Visual changes:[/b]
Changed the overlay of points and the “zeroing zone” and the buttons for opening and closing the tutorial for the dice mini-game
Fixed display of letters in the mailbox
The Back button in the main menu now returns to the previous menu instead of the main one
Escape in the main menu now duplicates the Back button
Now, when installing interior items, you immediately see what this object looks like
List height changes for the Delivery section
Separation of dishes and chemicals in the warehouse to visually determine what your restaurant is missing


[b]Bugs:[/b]
Fixed a bug when an object during installation was always in the status "Unavailable for installation"
Fixed a bug that reduced the number of bricks in a player's inventory when trying to throw a brick while holding a box.
Fixed a bug that allowed you to open the main menu in dialogue mode and interact with an object
Fixed a bug with the clock when it could not be hung above the doorway
Fixed a bug when clients left with a quest from a competitor
Fixed a bug when a competitor did not close the doors of his restaurant
Fixed a bug when a player walked through an employee
Fixed a bug when it was possible to open the interaction menu in the mode of moving objects
Fixed a bug where broken glass was restored after loading
Fixed a bug where the employee's skin was not saved


[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]
The fireplace can now be turned on and off
The computer enemy no longer prevents you from hiring the first employee for each profession, provided that the person being hired has the status "Out of work"
You can no longer use Build Mode, Catalog, Move Objects, or Pick a Door with a Box in Your Hands
The police will now confiscate stolen goods if you go to jail
Now a computer enemy can steal your products
Added Alfredo - master key merchant
Lockpicks are no longer infinite
The player initially has no master keys
The master key breaks when an attempt to open the door fails.
Gas can only be opened or closed if there is a valve
You can buy the valve in the city from the flower and fertilizer merchant
Added automatic switching on and off of restaurant lighting
Separated areas for unloading products and plates with chemicals. Each group has its own warehouse


[b]Other:[/b]
Editing product store prices
Editing positions for fireplaces
Fixed installation distance for objects when moving
Taxi cost reduced from $50 to $20
Rebalanced salaries for all professions
The valve on the competitor's gas pipeline was removed from the start of the game
Added saving the status of the gas tap (whether the valve is on or not)
